from __future__ import print_function
import openpyxl

status_path = '/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78536146/inputs/dataset_6955b5af-94f9-469b-a283-d865876d56a4.dat'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(status_path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
ws = wb[wb.get_sheet_names()[0]]
rows = ws.iter_rows()
header = [c.value for c in next(rows)]
idx = {}
for i, h in enumerate(header):
    if h is not None:
        idx[str(h).strip()] = i
required = ['Sample ID', 'Sex', 'BLM Mutation Status', 'Age']
missing = [h for h in required if h not in idx]
if missing:
    raise Exception('missing columns: ' + ','.join(missing))
oldest = None
for row in rows:
    values = [c.value for c in row]
    sample = values[idx['Sample ID']]
    sex = values[idx['Sex']]
    status = values[idx['BLM Mutation Status']]
    age = values[idx['Age']]
    if sample is None or sex is None or status is None or age is None:
        continue
    if str(sex).strip().upper() != 'M':
        continue
    if str(status).strip().lower() != 'carrier':
        continue
    age_num = float(age)
    sample_text = str(sample).strip()
    if sample_text.endswith('.0'):
        sample_text = sample_text[:-2]
    rec = (age_num, sample_text, str(status).strip(), str(sex).strip())
    if oldest is None or rec[0] > oldest[0]:
        oldest = rec
if oldest is None:
    raise Exception('no male carrier found')
with open('oldest_carrier.tsv', 'w') as out:
    out.write('sample_id\tage\tsex\tblm_mutation_status\n')
    out.write('%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' % (oldest[1], oldest[0], oldest[3], oldest[2]))
